subject: coord_flip() and scales = 'free' dont seem to interact well

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: coord_flip() and scales = 'free' dont seem to interact well
parts:
I am trying to write a function which plots regression results from
multiple models based on www.tables2graphs.com. I have created a gist
with my code http://gist.github.com/588339. Here is my problem. When I
run the code for creating Plot 2, the option scales = 'free' in the
facets doesn't seem to work. I tried changing the position of
coord_flip() in the formula, but none of the positions seem to create
free scales.

plot2 = ggplot(df, aes(x = model, y = est)) +
geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci.lo1, ymax = ci.hi1)) +
coord_flip() +
facet_grid(. ~ var, scales = 'free') +
theme_bw();

Any suggestions on how to make scales work for this plot?

Thanks.

Cheers,
Ramnath

messages.author: 5196f936ff792c35
messages.subject: Re: coord_flip() and scales = 'free' dont seem to interact well
parts:
I know it's not as elegant, but will this work for you? 

ggplot(df, aes(x = est, y = model)) +
geom_point() +
geom_errorbarh(aes(x= est, xmin = ci.lo1, xmax = ci.hi1, height=0))+
facet_grid(.~ var, scales = 'free') +
theme_bw()

Brandon

messages.author: d14865eaebfa2926
messages.subject: Re: coord_flip() and scales = 'free' dont seem to interact well
parts:
On a similar note

...+ facet_grid(variable~., scales="free_y") + coord_flip()

only shows 1 set of y-axis labels at the bottom ("y-axis" now at the
bottom when flipped), so the scale for one of the plots is wrong,
without the coord_flip() it correctly shows 2 sets of y-axis labels.

This is really a bug in coord_flip()
